messages:
maya: Heads up — our onboarding sampleapp (node) repros double-generation when a streaming request hits a 429 during token refresh. Seen this twice in staging.
tony: ugh. is it duplicate tokens being replayed or the client resending whole payload? any logs?
maya: logs show the client retries after refresh and we see two StartRequest traces within 100ms. streaming session id different but payload identical. snippet: 
```
2026-02-12T18:12:01.123Z INFO StartStream request_id=abcd-1 user_id=acct-123 model=gpt-4o
2026-02-12T18:12:01.224Z WARN  token_refresh triggered for acct-123
2026-02-12T18:12:01.330Z INFO StartStream request_id=abcd-2 user_id=acct-123 model=gpt-4o
```
looks like SDK sends a fresh StartStream after refresh instead of resuming.
anika: which SDK version? node or python? we fixed a similar non-streaming scenario before.
maya: node sdk v1.8.2. python not reproing. Node has auto-reconnect + built-in retry; it probably replays without idempotency. sampleapp attaches `X-Request-ID` but not idempotency header.
samir: we intentionally didn't add idempotency for streaming Start events because of resume complexity. but if token refresh triggers a full re-Start, we should detect duplicate in runtime (same client payload + recent window).
ryan: proposal: SDK should attach Idempotency-Key header for top-level start calls (non-resumable), and for resumable streams include a resume_token. For server-side, implement a short dedupe cache keyed by (acct, model, idempotency-key) with TTL 2s and soft-allow resume if mismatch.\
anika: 2s TTL might be too short under network jitter. we saw edge cases at ~4s during heavy GC. maybe 10s safe? need to balance memory.\
tony: also need jitter on client retry to avoid stampede. current client retry is immediate after refresh. add randomized backoff: base 100-300ms + expo up to 2s for 429s. Example pseudocode: 
```js
// simple jitter
const wait = base * Math.pow(2, attempt) * (0.5 + Math.random()/2)
await sleep(wait)
```
that spreads retries and reduces duplicate starts.\
maya: good call. in sampleapp I can add idempotency header and jitter locally to prove it fixes dupes. can someone own runtime dedupe TTL decision? I can open a PR for SDK change.\
samir: ops prefers server-side 429-safe replay policy: if we get two StartStream within 10s with same payload and same account, correlate and treat second as resume if stream state exists OR drop it if the original is still within ActiveStream window. we already keep KV cache per-account for prefix cache; reuse that.\
ryan: we must be careful for true concurrent requests (different users or parallel UX). key should include client-sent idempotency-key; server fallback when missing: use hash(payload+user+recent-nonce).\
anika: tests: create an e2e reproducer that forces token refresh mid-request, then asserts at most one active generation for same idempotency-key. add unit tests for dedupe cache eviction.\
maya: i'll push a small patch to sampleapp to add Idempotency-Key header and jitter in 10m. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/842 (draft)\
tony: can you add a repro script and steps in PR description so SRE can run in staging? also tag devx-team.\
maya: done — added a stress script that simulates 50 concurrent short tokens expiring, plus logs to show whether duplicates occur. early run shows dupes drop from ~12% to ~1.2%.\
devx-bot: deploy bot: staging run scheduled on cluster-03 at 2026-02-12T20:00Z. link: https://deploys.redwood/cluster-03/1234\
samir: next steps: (1) Maya PR to land sampleapp changes, (2) Tony/Runtime to prototype short dedupe cache @ 10s with metrics, (3) Anika to add SDK retry jitter + idempotency-key default in next minor. I'll create cards.\
maya: thanks — i'll update onboarding guide so users know to set Idempotency-Key for long-running/stream starts and we can default in the SDK later.\
ryan: please add a short note to the SDK migration doc — mention that resume_token is different from idempotency-key and intended for resuming only.\
anika: ack, i'll include a code snippet and test matrix. closing loop after runtime metrics are in.
